{{Short description|Organization of Hungary}}
The '''Hungarian Actuarial Society''' was founded in 1991 to represent [[actuary|actuaries]] in [[Hungary]]. {{As of|2004}}, it has about 140 members, 80 of which are qualified (full) members. It is a full member of the [[International Actuarial Association]] and the [[Groupe Consultatif]].
